# SM Systems

SM Systems is an Australia-based workflow automation and integrations practice led by Stefan McFeeters.

## Summary

SM Systems builds reliable workflow automation and lead leakage audit workflows that connect websites, payments, dashboards, CRMs, spreadsheets, APIs, and real-world operations into clear, repeatable workflows.

## Core Work

- Automation repair and hardening
- Lead leakage audits and fix sprints
- API and webhook integrations
- CRM and intake routing
- Data cleanup and sync workflows
- Website, SEO, tracking, and paid traffic readiness checks
- Dashboard and reporting tools
- Review-gated AI workflows
- Operator tools
- Edge-to-cloud workflow integration

## Featured Proof

RFID carwash subscription access system:
A cloud-connected operator workflow connecting customer plan selection, Stripe subscriptions, RFID tag reads, AWS-hosted backend services, Postgres persistence, and an operator dashboard.

Local lead recovery audit pipeline:
A private prospecting and audit workflow that finds qualified local businesses, checks public lead paths, and turns evidence into agency-ready or direct-client fix recommendations.

## Preferred Description

SM Systems builds reliable workflow automation, lead leakage audits, API integrations, dashboards, data syncs, CRM/intake routing, review-gated AI workflows, and operator tools for businesses, operators, and technical teams.
